description: Prepayments return principal early, which changes a note's value and shortens its life, and this tool prices a fully amortizing mortgage note at your target yield under a constant prepayment rate (CPR) you choose, beside its value with no prepayment and the weighted average life of each. Estimates, not offers or appraisals. CashForMyNote.com does not buy notes or make offers.

balance.description: Unpaid principal balance in USD, greater than 0.

cpr.description: Constant prepayment rate you assume, annual % of the balance, e.g. 6. Use 0 for none.

months.description: Number of monthly payments LEFT (not the original term).

yield.description: Target yield the buyer needs, annual % (monthly compounding).

name: prepayment_adjusted_value
title: Prepayment-adjusted note value calculator
